entities.summary: Nebuchadnezzar, a notable figure in the history of Israel, associated with Ancient Israelite Kingdoms (930 BCE–586 BCE). Preceded by Divided Kingdoms and Babylonian Exile and Solomon builds the First Temple in Jerusalem. Their legacy influenced Assyria conquers the Kingdom of Israel and deports the Ten Tribes.
